ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity dominance; approximately 85% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across central surfaces with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at the distal edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary black contiguous region occupying the central and lower 75% of the visible area; high-contrast white focal clusters mapped to the left and right distal tips and trailing edge margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximate interior angle of 48 degrees with high-depth penetration into the central fluke mass.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations; prominent peaks exceeding 20 pixels in height on the far-left lateral margin and consistent jagged peaks along the superior trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves originating from the median notch, transitioning to highly irregular, non-uniform jagged trajectories at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of approximately 30-40 circular white rosettes along the entire lateral edge of the left lobe; smaller clusters present on the superior tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the central-right lobe surface, showing low-intensity grey contrast against the black base pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive calcareous encrustations (barnacle colonization) creating structural deformity and increased surface area on the left lobe tip; irregular jagged scarring on the right lobe distal edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical barnacle distribution with extreme density on the left fluke margin compared to sparse colonization on the right.
